context: Major cycle: integrate the new Anthropic model Claude Fable 5 (claude-fable-5, Mythos-class above Opus 4.8, GA 2026-06-09, added to Claude Code in v2.1.170) and the security-relevant features of the v2.1.163→170 Claude Code releases. Evidence base is a dedicated /deep-research L4 report (reports/claude-code-fable5-2026-06-10.md) run on Opus 4.8; load-bearing claims (CLI --model token, env var names, CVE) were triangulated against the local install (claude --help, ~/.claude/cache/changelog.md) and GHSA/NVD — 2 Wave-1 claims were corrected. NOTE: this cycle was intended to run on Fable 5 (dogfood) but Fable 5's real-time cyber/biology safety classifier auto-switched the session to Opus 4.8 on Sentinel's security content — an empirical finding folded into REC-003/004.
exploitation_note: Maintained at 98. The new model (Fable 5) is now tracked and usable across the toolchain (feature-inventory, pattern-gen whitelist, skill model-tier guidance), and the genuinely new security surfaces (OTEL user-prompt telemetry leak, Claude Code control-disable env vars) are now covered by KB rules. The CVE (MCP TS SDK ReDoS) is left to the cve-sync feed.

recommendations.title: Extend LLM-DEBUG-001 to OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS

Description extended; +4 patterns, +1 negative pattern (now 16 patterns total).

impact.description: Closes the user-prompt/system-prompt telemetry-leak gap (CWE-532, OWASP-LLM02/06:2025).

recommendations.title: New rule LLM-CCHARDEN-001 — Claude Code defensive controls disabled
recommendations.description: Detects CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE=1 / --safe-mode (disables CLAUDE.md, plugins, skills, hooks, MCP — a monitoring/guardrail bypass), CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS / disableBundledSkills (shrinks defensive surface), and API_FORCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT=0 (indefinite stream hang — DoS / slow exfil) when set in committed/CI/managed config. MEDIUM, cvss_v4 5.9, CWE-693/16/400, OWASP-LLM06:2025.

impact.description: Detects self-disabling of Claude Code's own security controls — a new misconfiguration surface from v2.1.163-169.
